        )

        self.spy_previous_sma = None
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.aapl_lot = 0

        self.aapl_order_pending = False

        bars = data.Bars

        spy_bar = bars[self.spy] if self.spy in bars else None
        aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl] if self.aapl in bars else None

        previous_spy_close = self.spy_previous_close
        previous_spy_sma = self.spy_previous_sma

        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
            self.spy_previous_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.spy_previous_sma = (
                self.spy_sma.Current.Value
                if self.spy_sma.IsReady
                else None
            )

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
                if aapl_bar.Close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_bar.Close
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

        if any(symbol not in bars for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
            return

        spy_crossed_above = (
            self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and previous_spy_close is not None
            and previous_spy_sma is not None
            and previous_spy_close <= previous_spy_sma
            and spy_bar.Close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        )

            self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and previous_spy_close is not None
            and previous_spy_sma is not None
            and previous_spy_close >= previous_spy_sma
            and spy_bar.Close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        )

            self.aapl_previous_close is not None

        )

            self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
        )

            and not self.spy_order_pending

        ):
            self.spy_order_pending = True
            self.MarketOrder(
                self.spy,
                -self.spy_lot,
                tag="Strategy A sell"
            )

        if (
            self.aapl_lot > 0
            and not self.aapl_order_pending
            and aapl_rsi_above_60
        ):
            self.aapl_order_pending = True
            self.MarketOrder(
                self.aapl,
                -self.aapl_lot,
                tag="Strategy B sell"
            )

        if (
            self.spy_lot == 0
            and not self.spy_order_pending
            and spy_crossed_above
        ):
            quantity = self.CalculateOrderQuantity(self.spy, 0.40)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.spy_order_pending = True
                self.MarketOrder(
                    self.spy,
                    quantity,
                    tag="Strategy A buy"
                )

        if (
            self.aapl_lot == 0
            and not self.aapl_order_pending
            and aapl_red_for_three_days
            and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000

            quantity = floor(20_000 / float(aapl_bar.Close))
            if quantity > 0:
                self.aapl_order_pending = True
                self.MarketOrder(
                    self.aapl,
                    quantity,
                    tag="Strategy B buy"
                )

        order = self.Transactions.GetOrderById(order_event.OrderId)
        if order is None:

            if order_event.FillQuantity != 0:
                self.spy_lot += int(order_event.FillQuantity)

            if status in [
                OrderStatus.Filled,

                self.aapl_order_pending = False
